meta_title: I.S.G Painter & Decorator | Professional Painting Newcastle
meta_description: I.S.G Painter & Decorator in Newcastle. Expert interior and exterior painting, decorating, and wall treatments. Free quotes, reliable local service.
hero_subhead: From tired walls to beautiful interiors. We handle residential and commercial projects across Newcastle with precision and care.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: Whether you need a single room refreshed or a whole-house transformation, we deliver quality finishes on time and within budget.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls. We prep surfaces properly and use quality paints to ensure a finish that lasts years, not months.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's exterior. We handle weather-resistant coatings, fascias, soffits, and rendered walls to keep your property looking sharp.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Professional wallpaper installation or careful removal. We match patterns perfectly and leave surfaces clean for whatever comes next.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Doors, skirting, architraves, and built-in cupboards. We sand, fill, and paint to a standard that makes wood detailing shine.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Offices, shops, and industrial units. We work around your business hours and leave minimal disruption. Schedules we can stick to.

services.title: Specialist Coatings & Effects
services.desc: Textured finishes, modern paint effects, and bespoke colour matching. Tired of plain walls? We'll create something that stands out.

about_pullquote: We finish every job like we're painting our own living room.
about_para_1: I.S.G Painter & Decorator was founded on the simple principle that your home deserves better than a quick coat and a wave goodbye. Over 15 years, we've built our reputation by showing up on time, taking pride in surface prep, and using materials that actually last. From terraced houses in Winlaton to period properties across Gateshead, we've learned what works in the North East climate.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen first, quote fairly, and don't leave a mess behind. We're not the cheapest, but we're reliable and honest. That matters more when it's your home. Whether it's a bedroom refresh or a full exterior repaint, we treat every project with the same care and attention.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About I.S.G

reviews.text: Had our lounge and hallway completely redecorated. They arrived bang on time, protected all the furniture properly, and the finish is immaculate. Price was fair and they didn't leave us with a nightmare to clean up. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael H.

reviews.text: External rendering and woodwork done to a very high standard. They explained what needed doing before they started and stuck to the quote. No hidden extras. The work's held up beautifully through the winter too.
reviews.author: Catherine R.

reviews.text: Came to do a small touch-up job and ended up doing the whole kitchen after giving honest advice about what would look best. Really professional team, clean workers, and they got it done in the timescale promised. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David T.
